strings.guide.t.start.a: Laibu Inn sungah teikhiatna khat teel-in internet omlo-in zat theih dingin bawl in. Tua khit ciangin Laibu pane pan alian khat hong in, ahih kei leh Ctrl/⌘ P sungah “ps 23” bang lai mun khat gelh in.

internet omlo-in zat theih dingin bawl
internet omlo-in zat
no internet

strings.guide.t.offline.a: Laibu Inn sungah teikhiatna khat tungah “Internet omlo-in zat theih dingin bawl” mek in. Tua pan kipan a vekpi-in hih set sungah om a, internet kul nawn lo hi.

strings.guide.t.passage.q:
alian khat hong
aneu khat zong
laibu khat ah pai
navigate
lai mun khat hong
strings.guide.t.passage.a: Ctrl/⌘ O mek-in lai mun pen na gen bangin gelh in — “jn 3:16”, “1 cor 13”, “ps 23” — ahih kei leh teikhiatna ii ama laibu min tawh gelh in.

strings.guide.t.parallel.q:
teikhiatna etkak
parallel bible
Lai Siangtho nih khatvei thu-in
split view
strings.guide.t.parallel.a: Etkakna pane khat hong-in teikhiatna nihna teel in. Pane te aneu khat ciangin kikim-in om a, a kithuah-in kisuan hi.

kam khat zong
koi lai-ah gen hiam

kammal zonna
strings.guide.t.search.a: Ctrl/⌘ F in zonna hong hi. Gelhna mun tawpna-a switch te in kammal bup, regular expression ahih kei leh laimal lian kibatna teel a, a nuai-a huam sung in teikhiatna le laibute teel hi.

aneu khat kem

ciptehna

strings.guide.t.run.q:

lai mun khat ciamteh

aneu khat sangin tamzaw
strings.guide.t.run.a: A masa pen aneu nambat mek in, tua khit ciangin a nunung pen Shift tawh mek in. Thugelh ahih kei leh ciptehna in a kizom aneu a vekpi huam hi.

ni sim simna
tuni aneu

strings.guide.t.plan.a: Simding geelna pane sungah tuni aneu, simna khawlna mun ah ciah kikna, le Lai Siangtho a vekpi, Thuciam Thak, Lungdamna Thu le Late adingin geelnate om hi.

strings.guide.t.card.q:

aneu card
social media adingin lim
wallpaper
strings.guide.t.card.a: Palette sungah “card” le lai mun khat gelh in — “card ps 23:1-3” — tua ciangin card bawlna pen tua tungah kihong hi. Template, rong le laimal teel in, tua khit ciangin lim pen copy bawl in ahih kei leh kem in.

strings.guide.t.project.q:
sinna project
thugenna
thuhilhna geelna
lai munte kaikhawm
Lai Siangtho sinna
strings.guide.t.project.a: Project in thugenna ahih kei leh thuhilhna khat a kibawlna lai mun, thugelh le nasepte kem hi. Lai mun khat behlap nadingin palette sungah “project” le lai mun khat gelh in.

strings.guide.t.import.q:

keima Lai Siangtho zang

tracking
account

strings.guide.t.privacy.a: A vekpi hih set sungah om hi: thugelh, ciptehna, project le lamlahna in a sinte. Teikhiatnate pen a kingen ciangin download kibawl a, nangma thu bangmah koi mah ah kipuak lo hi.

strings.guide.t.strongs.a: Teikhiatna khat in Strong nambat a neih leh status bar pan lak in, tua khit ciangin a lexicon thu en nadingin khat mek in.

strings.guide.t.guide.q:

strings.guide.t.guide.a: Lamlahna in hih app in ama thu a theihna pan dawng a, koi dawnnate kizang cih sin hi. Tua pen hih set sungah om hi; Dan → Sinna in mangngilh sak hi.
strings.guide.t.help.title: Lamlahna in a huh theihte
strings.guide.t.help.q:
bangci hong huh thei na hiam
what can you do
bang dong thei ka hiam
hong huh in
hih bang hiam
hih app in bang bawl thei hiam
strings.guide.t.help.a: Hih lai-ah bangci bawl ding cih nangma kammal tawh dong in — “aneu khat ciamteh”, “laimal lian zaw”, “a ging in sim”, “use a regular expression” — tua ciangin dawnna pen a bawl button tawh hong pai hi. Tua lai-ah pai nadingin john 3:16 bang lai mun khat gelh in. Hih app in ama thu a theihna pan, internet omlo-in dawng hi. Hun le ni, laibu, alian le aneu bangzah om cih zong thei a (“how many verses in John 3”), screen kimkot zong hong lak thei hi: “take the tour”.

strings.cv.whoNote: Hih app thu le Lai Siangtho ii laibu, alian le aneu te tawh kisai dotna te, hih set sunga om te pan ka dawng hi. Kei pen mihing ka hi kei a, AI model zong ka hi kei hi: na dot khat beek hih set pan pusuak lo hi.
strings.cv.startNote: Ctrl+O le lai mun khat gelh leh lai mun khat peuhpeuh hong thei hi; aneu nambat meek leh aneu tawh bawl theih te kilak hi; etkhiatna in na khempeuh omna hong lak hi.
strings.cv.tourNote: Screen kimkot ah kalsuan tawmkhat, khat ciangin mun khat lak hi. Koi kalsuan ah zongin kantan theih hi.
strings.cv.helloNote: Bangci bawl ding cih, ahih kei leh laibu khat in alian bangzah nei cih dong in. “What can you do?” cih in adangte hong lak hi.
strings.cv.thanksNote: Bang hun peuhin dong kik in; Lamlahna pen taklam ah om hi, ahih kei leh palette sungah “?” gelh in.
strings.cv.byeNote: Na sim lai mun pen a zom ciang adingin kikem hi.
strings.tour.set: Sim thak khat tungah etkhiatna lak
strings.tour.setHint: Sim ding alian a om masak pen ciangin etkhiatna amah leh amah khatvei kipan hi. Na hong pai lungdam laimai, menu ahih kei leh palette pan bang hun peuhin et theih hi.
strings.tour.hello.b: Kalsuan tawmkhat, khat ciangin screen mun khat lak hi. Koi kalsuan ah zongin kantan theih hi; menu pan et kik theih hi.
strings.tour.reading.b: Na teel teikhiatna sunga alian. Ctrl+→ le Ctrl+← in a zom alian le a masa alian ah pai hi.
strings.tour.verse.b: Aneu nambat meek leh a tawh bawl theih te kilak hi: ciamteh, thu gelh, copy bawl, teikhiatna a vekpi ah etkak. Shift in aneu a kizom tampi teel hi.
strings.tour.passage.b: A dang teel dingin laibu ahih kei leh alian meek in, ahih kei leh Ctrl+O meek in gelh in: "ps 23", "jn 3:16".
strings.tour.tabs.b: Tab khat ciang lai mun khat ahih kei leh laimai khat hi. Lai mun khat tungah middle-click bawl leh ama tab ah kihong hi; tab khat pen window khat ah kai theih hi.
strings.tour.ribbon.b: Hon ding le bawl ding te, khatvei meek bek tawh. Button khat lakhia dingin right-click bawl in, ahih kei leh command khat peuhpeuh behlap in.
strings.tour.phone.b: Sim, zong, Laibu Inn, na sinna, le adang. A nuai lamah na sim suk ciangin kihem a, a tung lamah na kik ciangin hong kilang kik hi.
strings.tour.left.b: Veilam sidebar: laibu le alian a vekpi, teikhiatna khat sungah zonna, ciptehna, tag le simding geelna te. Ctrl+B in lak a, sel hi.
strings.tour.right.b: Taklam sidebar: alian' thulu gual, thugelh, link, kammal sinna le Lai mun pane. Pane khat peuhpeuh tab ah kai theih hi.
strings.tour.status.b: A kihong thu le a kikoih dan. A khat ciang button hi; lakhia dingin khat tungah right-click bawl in, koihkik dingin bar tungah right-click bawl in.
strings.tour.menu.b: Na hong pai lungdam, hih etkhiatna, huhna, dan le update te.
strings.tour.ask.b: Ctrl+P in na khempeuh a min tawh zong hi. Dotna dong dingin "?" tawh kipan in: "? how do I make a note", "? how many chapters in Psalms".
strings.set.tintStrongsHint: Teikhiatna khat in Strong nambat nei a, tuate a kisel ciangin, nambat nei kammalte rong tawmkhat kilamdang hi; tua in sin theih kammalte lak hi.

strings.ws.notANumber: “{text}” pen Strong nambat hilo hi. H430 ahih kei leh G26 bangin gelh in.
strings.ws.empty: Strong nambat nei kammal khat meek in “Hih kammal sin” teel in, ahih kei leh command palette sungah “study H430” gelh in.
strings.ws.lexImport: STEPBible' TBESH (Hebru) le TBESG (Greek) te Laibu Inn pan file-in guanglut theih hi.
strings.ws.noHebrew: Hih set sungah Strong nambat nei Hebru lai omlo hi. A kammal mahmah le a grammar mu dingin Laibu Inn pan khat guanglut in — Westminster Leningrad Codex (OpenScriptures OSIS), ahih kei leh eBible.org Hebru lai khat USFX ahih kei leh browserBible-in.
strings.ws.noGreek: Hih set sungah Strong nambat nei Greek lai omlo hi. A kammal mahmah le a grammar mu dingin Laibu Inn pan khat guanglut in — gentehna-in eBible.org Greek Thuciam Thak khat USFX ahih kei leh browserBible-in.

strings.guide.t.study.title: Kammal khat sin
strings.guide.t.study.q:
kammal sinna

hih kammal bangci teikhia hiam
concordance

strings.guide.t.study.a: Strong nambat te hong in, kammal khat meek in “Hih kammal sin” teel in: pau bulpi kammal le a grammar, lexicon sunga thu, le hih teikhiatna in tua adingin a zat kammal a vekpi, aneu te tawh. Palette sungah “study H430” in tua mah bawl hi.

strings.guide.t.originals.a: App in a kiang ah a kipuak file pan bek Hebru le Greek sim hi: Westminster Leningrad Codex pen OpenScriptures OSIS-in, ahih kei leh eBible.org Hebru ahih kei leh Greek lai khat USFX ahih kei leh browserBible-in. Strong nambat tawh a kiguanglut ciangin, kammal sinna le interlinear gual in a sim pau bulpi suak hi. STEPBible lexicon (TBESH, TBESG) zong tua mah bangin kiguanglut hi.

strings.guide.t.interlinear.a: Aneu khat ciang nuai-ah hih set sungah a kiguanglut Hebru ahih kei leh Greek, kammal khat khit khat a khiatna tawh mu dingin interlinear gual hong in. A lexicon sunga thu mu dingin a sunga kammal khat meek in.
